meta.title: JarvisMind Memory
meta.description: Automatic cross-session memory recall and capture, an always-on core anchor that preserves the user's name, tone and standing agreements across context compaction, plus explicit search, remember and forget tools, backed by a local JarvisMind server.

coreAnchorEnabled.title: Core anchor
coreAnchorEnabled.description: Inject the always-on <jarvismind-core-anchor> block so the user's name, form of address, core preferences and standing agreements survive context compaction and new sessions.

coreAnchorLimit.title: Core anchor memories
coreAnchorLimit.description: How many memories the core anchor keeps, from 1 to 12. Higher values preserve more of the relationship at the cost of prompt space.

coreAnchorMaxChars.title: Core anchor characters per memory
coreAnchorMaxChars.description: Maximum characters kept for each memory in the core anchor, from 100 to 2000. Long memories are truncated rather than dropped.
